# Entry removal

```gherkin design
Feature: Remove exactly the named entry
  The caller removes a title or a unique marker while preserving other entries.
  Not: editing entries or retrying a removal.

  Background:
    Given the supported sections
      | section   |
      | courses   |
      | education |

  @EntryPicker
  Rule: exact-title-wins — One equal title selects that entry before lookalikes or markers, ignoring case, spacing and doubled paint.
    Example: the exact title among lookalikes
      Given the titles "QAV Analyst" and "QAV Analyst 2"
      When the match is "QAV Analyst"
      Then the first entry is selected by title

  @EntryPicker
  Rule: title-tie-refused — Two or more equal titles select no entry.
    Example: two equal titles
      Given two entries titled "QAV Analyst"
      When the match is "QAV Analyst"
      Then no entry is selected

  @EntryPicker
  Rule: lookalike-refused — With no equal title, a longer title holding the match as a whole phrase prevents marker selection.
    Example: a lookalike blocks a unique marker
      Given "QAV Analyst 2" and a different entry whose description holds "QAV Analyst"
      When the match is "QAV Analyst"
      Then no entry is selected

  @EntryPicker
  Rule: single-marker — With no equal or lookalike title, one entry holding the whole phrase is selected by marker.
    Example: a marker in one description
      Given "Real Course" alone holds "marker 9971" in its description
      When the match is "marker 9971"
      Then "Real Course" is selected by marker

  @EntryPicker
  Rule: marker-tie-refused — With no equal or lookalike title, two or more entries holding the whole phrase select no entry.
    Example: two holders of a marker
      Given two different entries hold "marker 9971" in their descriptions
      When the match is "marker 9971"
      Then no entry is selected

  @EntryPicker
  Rule: unreadable-list — An unreadable list selects no entry.
    Example: the list cannot be read
      Given the list is unreadable
      When the match is "marker 9971"
      Then no entry is selected

  @EntryPicker @property
  Rule: match-is-literal — Pattern characters and adjacent letters or digits never widen a whole-phrase match.
    Example: brackets and pluses remain literal
      Given the titles "QA C" and "QA (C++)"
      When the match is "QA (C++)"
      Then only the second entry is selected

  @EditorCheck
  Rule: editor-proves-identity — Only one shown editor permits deletion, proving title mode by an equal single-line input without a longer matching input, or marker mode by a whole-phrase match in its text or input values.
    Scenario Outline: the editor proves the selected mode
      Given an editor containing <value>
      When its identity is checked in <mode> mode
      Then deletion is <allowed>
      Examples:
        | mode   | value           | allowed |
        | title  | QAV Analyst     | true    |
        | title  | QAV Analyst 2   | false   |
        | marker | note marker 9971 | true   |

  @RemoveSection
  Rule: match-required — A trimmed match shorter than three characters is refused before any page call.
    Example: a two-letter match is refused
      When removal runs with match " ab "
      Then the run is refused
      And the page receives no calls

  @assumption
  Rule: entry-title-is-first-line — The external site renders the title as the first text line of its row.
```

## Glossary
- **Whole phrase** — text with no letter or digit attached at either end.
- **Lookalike** — a longer title containing the match as a whole phrase.

```ts design
/** @data
 * @description A readable entry. */
export interface Entry { title: string; text: string; }
/** @data
 * @description The selected entry and the way it was identified. */
export interface Picked { index: number; mode: "title" | "marker"; }
/** @data
 * @description Observable editor values. */
export interface Editor { shown: boolean; inputs: readonly string[]; textareas: readonly string[]; text: string; }
/** @data
 * @description The page operations available to a removal. */
export interface Page {
  read(): readonly Entry[] | null;
  edit(index: number): readonly Editor[];
  delete(index: number): void;
  escape(): void;
}
/** @contract
 * @description Selects a single entry, or refuses. */
export interface EntryPicker { (entries: readonly Entry[] | null, match: string): Picked | null; }
/** @contract
 * @description Checks the selected entry's identity in an editor. */
export interface EditorCheck { (editors: readonly Editor[], target: Picked, match: string): boolean; }
/** @family
 * @description A removal capability sharing the input guard. */
export interface RemoveSection {}
/** @contract
 * @description Removes a course.
 * @uses EntryPicker EditorCheck */
export interface RemoveCourses extends RemoveSection { run(page: Page, match: string): void; }
/** @contract
 * @description Removes an education entry.
 * @uses EntryPicker EditorCheck */
export interface RemoveEducation extends RemoveSection { run(page: Page, match: string): void; }
```
